subject.title: Theme Customization System — Preset Themes + Custom Theme Studio

question: Should OpenClaw keep Control UI theming as Claw/Knot/Dash plus one browser-local tweakcn import slot, or sponsor a built-in preset gallery and custom theme studio with broader persistence?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally expose a narrower one-slot import model, while this issue requests a larger in-product authoring and persistence surface that needs product/design ownership before implementation.

options.title: Define a narrow core theming roadmap
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which preset picker, preview, editor, and persistence pieces belong in core before any implementation starts.

options.title: Keep tweakcn-only in core
options.body: Document the external editor plus import-slot path as the supported customization model and close or narrow the larger studio request after preserving the feedback.

options.title: Split staged theme work
options.body: Track interactive preview, gateway-backed persistence, accessibility presets, and local override editing as separate product-approved slices.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow core theming roadmap
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which preset picker, preview, editor, and persistence pieces belong in core before any implementation starts.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev is assigned on the live issue and authored the current tweakcn import and adjacent theme-model code that define the present boundary.
